svg.title: Index Translator server components, engines
svg.desc: The app builds the chat or document prompt and asks the translation engine for a generation. The engine owns a worker thread, which loads the model through the bindings file and calls libllama. The chat prompt is written by the bindings, not by the templates. An image is encoded by libmtmd on that same thread. The speech engine owns its own worker thread, which calls libaudiocpp through its bindings. It reads aloud, separates the voice of uploaded samples, and transcribes recordings, whose stream of segments is read by transcript.ts. Both engines talk to their workers through worker-rpc.ts. They share nothing but the process. a translation: src/app.ts → src/llama.ts → src/worker-rpc.ts → src/llama-worker.ts → src/llama-ffi.ts → libllama. reading or transcribing: src/app.ts → src/speech.ts → src/worker-rpc.ts → src/speech-worker.ts → src/audiocpp-ffi.ts → libaudiocpp.
